usage.source_scope: RoboPulse revision c3b2f7c; SC44 IDs excluded; six training sources, droid_oxe calibration, human_pika and libero_data evaluation.
usage.project_application: Endpoint progress recognition before HANDOFF_READY, with learned factors separated from deterministic progress/regression/UNKNOWN authority.
usage.modifications: 32 fixed factor scalars, StandardScaler plus fixed logistic regression, split-conformal alpha 0.25, source-held-out evaluation.
usage.expected_effect: Break constant-label VLM collapse and improve signed progress recognition while retaining explicit UNKNOWN.

evaluation.setup: SC44 IDs excluded; 1140 rows from six sources fit the fixed learner, 190 droid_oxe rows calibrated alpha 0.25 conformal sets, and 380 human_pika/libero_data rows stayed outcome-invisible until provider seal.
evaluation.effect: Global learned factors broke constant-progress collapse and improved same-known balanced accuracy by 3.47 points at 93.95 percent coverage, but missed the frozen 5 point gain gate and transferred unevenly to human-hand video.
evaluation.claim_boundary: SC45 reached 65.96 percent selective balanced accuracy at 93.95 percent coverage and plus 3.47 points over the same-known baseline, but missed the plus 5 point gate; no online identity, navigation, arrival, completion, product, or safety authority.

evidence.summary: Frozen SC45 source roles, factors, conformal reducer, and gate.
SC45 metrics, hashes, failure localization, and claim boundary.

history.change: Consumed SC45 split: do not tune C, alpha, source roles, factor weights, or thresholds. Next successor needs object and hand localized effect-carrier deltas on a new cohort.
